name: analytics
description: Mixed analytical workload over the generated datasets (financial, customers, join star, time series, sort keys, wide and null-heavy tables).

indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX bx_tx_merchant ON transactions (merchant_id) USING HASH
CREATE INDEX bx_tx_ts ON transactions (ts) USING BTREE

queries.name: q01_filter_selective
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE merchant_id = 17

queries.name: q02_filter_low_selectivity
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount), MAX(fee) FROM transactions WHERE status <> 'declined'

queries.name: q03_range_filter_time
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(amount) FROM transactions WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-03-01 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2024-03-08 00:00:00'

queries.name: q04_arith_aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount * 2 - fee), MIN(amount), MAX(amount), AVG(bucket) FROM transactions

queries.name: q05_groupby_low_card
queries.sql: SELECT currency, COUNT(*), SUM(amount), AVG(amount) FROM transactions GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

queries.name: q06_groupby_high_card
queries.sql: SELECT merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS s FROM transactions GROUP BY merchant_id ORDER BY s DESC, merchant_id LIMIT 10

queries.name: q07_groupby_skewed
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10

queries.name: q08_groupby_uniform_multi
queries.sql: SELECT bucket % 100 AS b, category, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM transactions GROUP BY bucket % 100, category ORDER BY b, category LIMIT 50

queries.name: q09_distinct_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) FROM transactions

queries.name: q10_join_customers
queries.sql: SELECT c.segment, c.country, COUNT(*), SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment, c.country ORDER BY c.segment, c.country

queries.name: q11_join_star
queries.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*), SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

queries.name: q12_left_join_anti
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

queries.name: q13_sort_topn
queries.sql: SELECT id, uniq_key FROM sort_keys ORDER BY uniq_key LIMIT 100

queries.name: q14_sort_full_string
queries.sql: SELECT id, str_key FROM sort_keys ORDER BY str_key, id

queries.name: q15_sort_multi_key
queries.sql: SELECT dup_key, float_key, id FROM sort_keys ORDER BY dup_key DESC, float_key, id

queries.name: q16_timeseries_hourly
queries.sql: SELECT sensor_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', ts) AS h, AVG(temperature), MAX(humidity) FROM sensor_readings WHERE sensor_id <= 20 GROUP BY sensor_id, DATE_TRUNC('hour', ts) ORDER BY sensor_id, h LIMIT 100

queries.name: q17_wide_projection
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(c000), MAX(c050), MIN(c099) FROM wide WHERE c003 = true

queries.name: q18_nulls
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(n50), COUNT(n90), SUM(n50), COUNT(*) FROM nulls_heavy WHERE s70 IS NOT NULL OR b60 = true

queries.name: q19_cte_subquery
queries.sql: WITH per_c AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_c WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM per_c)

queries.name: q20_string_functions
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(LENGTH(category)), SUM(CASE WHEN category LIKE '%e%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM transactions WHERE UPPER(currency) = 'EUR'
